integrity: Standalone checker passed 96 parameter cases, 1512 signed character comparisons, and 30 exact integer Smith computations; the infinite claim depends on the written proof. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Known ordinary homotopy and Betti ranks are credited to arXiv:2001.05448, Theorem 3.5. The new theorem concerns integral modules and coinvariants for complete bipartite graphs; equivariant homotopy types and other graph families remain outside scope. Equivalent unindexed literature is possible.
title: Integral automorphism modules of complete-bipartite higher-independence complexes
